requests.summary: Explicit combined report breakdowns are independently selected and compiled from a single validated scope, preventing substitution by campaign-level rates.

investigation.cause: Draft planning substituted default campaign-rate measurements for explicit tracking breakdowns. Review saw the proposed grouping and approved it without a separately checked grouping requirement.
investigation.correction: Independent review selects explicit dataset/dimension pairs without seeing draft dimensions. Native capabilities validate each pair. A single unambiguous report scope compiles those verified breakdowns using existing query validation; incomplete multi-scope plans require bounded replanning before reads. Fixed-observation tracking dimensions retain empty metric lists. No keyword-based grouping router or new data capability was added.
investigation.before: Fresh synthetic local replay reproduced campaign grouping while omitting the requested two tracking dimensions.
investigation.after: Fresh synthetic local replay returned country and device observations, retained the selected dates and existing tracking limitations, and used three model calls.
investigation.replays: Private question was supplied only through temporary input. Synthetic in-memory report fixtures and read-only dedicated-worktree source mounts; local model endpoint only. No production records, inference or writes.
investigation.manual_and_source: The Comprehensive User Guide requires checking dataset, grouping, metrics and exact dates; Locations and clients is an existing report view. Native analytics supplies distinct messages with observed engagement by country/device, with proxy/unknown and delivery limitations. No manual, index or PDF content changed.
investigation.deferred_review: Prior local email-scope correction was preserved through the main merge. Historical UI visibility, availability, sustained production latency and the previously blocked test-only replay have no resolving new evidence and remain deferred.

limitations: Local synthetic timings do not establish production latency after deployment.
Compilation applies only when one report query supplies an unambiguous validated scope; multi-scope omissions retain bounded retries.
Report grouping requirements remain model-selected typed evidence; they do not add unsupported data or permissions.
